claims.value: 14 gel slices of albumin-depleted Cook Cleavage Medium K11935
claims.evidence: 'gel cut into 14 slices'; run names IVF5ml-Gel-1..14; .dat FILE path '2013-06 - IVF 5ml Albumin Depletion'; 5 ml Cook Cleavage Medium depleted. Medium identity inferred from '5 ml' and Cook Cleavage being the 5 ml-depleted medium
Albumin depletion protocol applies only to gel samples
Protocol: TripleTOF 5600+; PSI-MS has no 5600+ term, PRIDE instrument field is TripleTOF 5600. reconcile flags this (accepted)

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed (in-solution); Propionamide C fixed (gel); Oxidation M variable
claims.evidence: MODS= and IT_MODS= in deposited Mascot .dat headers. Paper also lists hydroxyproline variable but .dat headers show only Oxidation (M); deposit followed
INFERRED from Mascot INSTRUMENT=ESI-QUAD-TOF (CID spectra); not stated explicitly
15 mM DTT, 30 mM iodoacetamide for in-solution; gel samples reduced with 50 mM DTT in sample buffer, no alkylation reagent stated (propionamide from acrylamide)
Mascot-searched MS/MS peak lists; DDA not stated explicitly (inferred from TripleTOF IDA workflow/Mascot search)

limitations: Full text not read; PRIDE protocol text used.
Gel sample medium inferred as Cook Cleavage K11935; G-MM depletion mentioned in protocol but no G-MM gel runs identified in deposit.
Human template not applied: samples are culture media, not individuals; age/sex not meaningful.
